title: Law Of Contract Ii
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an equitable and exists in a number of circumstances."
The right of rescission is an equitable and exists in a number of circumstances.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the loss flowing naturally from the breach and incurred in direct consequence of the violation."
The measure of damages is the loss flowing naturally from the breach and incurred in direct consequence of the violation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an untrue statement of a fact which materially induced a party to enter into a contract."
Misrepresentation is an untrue statement of a fact which materially induced a party to enter into a contract.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important stipulation in the contract that goes to the root of the contract, the breach of which entitles the innocent party to a discharge or repudiation."
A condition is an important stipulation in the contract that goes to the root of the contract, the breach of which entitles the innocent party to a discharge or repudiation.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a rule of procedure so, a judgment in a foreign currency can be satisfied by payment of the sum due in that currency or sterling converted as at the date of the judgment."
The rules laid down is a rule of procedure so, a judgment in a foreign currency can be satisfied by payment of the sum due in that currency or sterling converted as at the date of the judgment.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the compulsion under which a person acts through fear of personal suffering from injury to the body or from confinement, actual or threatened."
Duress is the compulsion under which a person acts through fear of personal suffering from injury to the body or from confinement, actual or threatened.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the consideration which makes the agreement operational."
The satisfaction is the consideration which makes the agreement operational.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a creature of both Common Law and Statute; and both have prima-facie excluded certain persons from having full contractual capacity."
Once again legal capacity is a creature of both Common Law and Statute; and both have prima-facie excluded certain persons from having full contractual capacity.

Equally illegal is an agreement involving the publication of a libel Clay v.

Thgis is the rule laid down by Alderson, B. in the leading English case of Hadley v.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important consideration in granting specific performance."
The conduct of plaintiff is an important consideration in granting specific performance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the objective one of reasonableness."
The test of negligence is the objective one of reasonableness.

A 'true legal agency' is an individual, which the law recognizes as being capable of creating a contract which is binding on a principal and the third party with whom the agent has dealt.
fib: ______ is a decree, which is ordered by the court, which directs a contracting party to perform the contract which he has promised to do.
Specific performance
Specific performance is a decree, which is ordered by the court, which directs a contracting party to perform the contract which he has promised to do.

Undue influence
Undue influence is a doctrine of duress as too narrow.
______ is an equitable remedy and applicable under discretionary ground.
injunction
An injunction is an equitable remedy and applicable under discretionary ground.

accord

contract released

Rectification as a remedy is a device that is an exception to the parol evidence rule.

According to the course material, how many types of duress namely are there? (answer in figures)
two

There are two types of duress namely: 3.2.1 Duress at Common Law Duress, which is a common law doctrine, means any actual or threatened violence imprisonment or restraint of personal liberty of a person, his wife, child, parent or relatives which induces him to enter into a contract against his will.
